minutes.headline: Boards unanimously appointed Stephanie Quinn to the Montachusett Regional Vocational School Committee.
minutes.summary: A short joint meeting of the Select Board, School Committee and Moderator appointed Stephanie Quinn to the Monty Tech school committee and authorized a Council on Aging services agreement with MART, then closed. The regularly scheduled Tri-Board meeting that followed consisted entirely of preliminary FY27 budget presentations from the DPW, Facilities, Fire and Police departments, covering staffing needs, a proposed storm water utility, TCP building decommissioning, and a proposed fourth fire shift; no budget votes were taken.

budget_items.topic: MART Council on Aging agreement - insurance language
budget_items.what_was_said: The agreement's insurance clause for MART was holdover language never actually charged; town staff said it was a cleanup, not a substantive change.

budget_items.topic: DPW snow/ice: own equipment vs. hiring out
budget_items.what_was_said: Bill Bernard said an analysis showed it is cheaper to use town equipment and operators than to hire private vendors, based on the cost of the highest-paid heavy equipment operator.

budget_items.topic: New CDL plow truck (capital)
budget_items.what_was_said: The DPW director plans to request a new CDL-class dump truck in this year's capital request, noting the price has risen sharply since he first priced the same truck in 2022.

budget_items.topic: Snow and ice deficit spending
budget_items.what_was_said: The DPW director said the department has run a deficit in the snow and ice budget over the last five years and plans a 2.5% annual increase to reduce, but not eliminate, it.

budget_items.topic: MS4 stormwater permit compliance risk
budget_items.what_was_said: Failure to comply with the federal MS4 stormwater permit could carry penalties, though the director does not expect the town would actually be fined that amount.

budget_items.topic: Proposed storm water utility fee
budget_items.what_was_said: The DPW director said the plan is a flat annual fee for residential properties, with a sliding scale for businesses based on impervious surface.

budget_items.topic: Storm water utility revenue target vs. current spending
budget_items.what_was_said: The DPW director said the target is to collect roughly a set amount annually through the new utility, well above what the current storm water/drainage budget spends.

budget_items.topic: DPW capital plan, FY27-FY29
budget_items.what_was_said: The DPW director gave a preliminary multi-year capital outlook covering equipment replacement and drainage/bridge engineering and construction.

budget_items.topic: Cost difference if storm water utility is not enacted
budget_items.what_was_said: The director said drainage and storm water line items would need to be higher in FY28 and FY29 if the utility is not approved, compared with if it is.

budget_items.topic: Chapter 90 funding assumption
budget_items.what_was_said: The DPW director said he assumed the typical annual Chapter 90 amount going forward, not the doubled amount received this year, because it is uncertain whether the increase continues.

budget_items.topic: Fair share (Millionaires Tax) revenue
budget_items.what_was_said: A board member asked whether fair share money promised when voters supported the tax would continue; the DPW director said that was uncertain.

budget_items.topic: TCP building revolving account deficit closeout
budget_items.what_was_said: Officials recalled a one-time payment made at special town meeting to zero out a negative TCP revolving fund balance that had built up because the building had no real operating budget.

budget_items.topic: TCP building heating fuel
budget_items.what_was_said: The facilities director said TCP's gas bill has historically run around a certain amount and he is projecting roughly half that as the building is partially decommissioned.

budget_items.topic: Contracted cleaning services
budget_items.what_was_said: The facilities director restored the cleaning contract budget to its FY25 level after issues with the cleaning contractor.

budget_items.topic: TCP expense line / lost rent offset
budget_items.what_was_said: A line was added back to the facilities budget to cover the loss of rent revenue after the extended day program left the TCP building.

budget_items.topic: Food pantry electricity use at TCP
budget_items.what_was_said: The facilities director estimated the food pantry's refrigeration equipment accounts for a large share of TCP's electric cost, with an equipment-rated estimate versus a measured range.

budget_items.topic: Asbestos abatement cost estimate (TCP decommissioning)
budget_items.what_was_said: The facilities director said he has not fully estimated the abatement cost for the decommissioned half of the TCP building but would not be surprised if it reached a certain figure; this would be requested as a capital item.

budget_items.topic: TCP building internet cost
budget_items.what_was_said: The facilities director noted the building now carries a commercial internet cost, mainly for the public access studio, higher than he expected.

budget_items.topic: Fire Dept. FY27 salary increase for 4th shift
budget_items.what_was_said: The fire chief said the salary increase reflects three step-two firefighter paramedics and one promotion to lieutenant, based on the current collective bargaining agreement.

budget_items.topic: Fire Dept. career overtime increase
budget_items.what_was_said: The chief said overtime would rise due to additional time off accrued by new staff and a higher overtime rate under the new work-week schedule.

budget_items.topic: Fire Dept. holiday pay increase
budget_items.what_was_said: Holiday pay would increase to cover three additional staff and a higher average overtime rate.

budget_items.topic: Fire Dept. total salary-side increase
budget_items.what_was_said: The chief summarized the combined increase across hiring and overtime lines needed to fund a fourth shift.

budget_items.topic: Fire Dept. benefits (OPEB) cost of new hires
budget_items.what_was_said: The chief said the benefits estimate for the new positions, developed with HR and finance, assumes a worst-case top-end family health plan.

budget_items.topic: Fire Dept. total requested budget increase
budget_items.what_was_said: The chief gave the combined total increase across salary and benefits needed to add the fourth shift.

budget_items.topic: Fire Dept. EMS supplies and equipment maintenance
budget_items.what_was_said: The chief requested an increase to cover rising costs of medication, oxygen, disposable supplies and required annual servicing of paramedic-level equipment.

budget_items.topic: Fire Dept. vehicle maintenance / prior reserve fund transfer
budget_items.what_was_said: The chief noted he had requested a reserve fund transfer this past fiscal year to cover an ambulance repair, part of a broader increase needed in vehicle maintenance.

budget_items.topic: Fire Dept. total requested expense-line increase
budget_items.what_was_said: The chief gave the total requested increase across the department's expense lines.

budget_items.topic: Police lockup costs / Worcester County Sheriff program
budget_items.what_was_said: The police chief said housing male prisoners through the Worcester County Sheriff's program sharply cut the lockup budget from what it used to run.

budget_items.topic: Nashoba Valley regional dispatch cost
budget_items.what_was_said: The police chief said the town's share of regional dispatch costs stays roughly steady regardless of call volume, split evenly among member towns by formula.

budget_items.topic: Police vehicle maintenance - hybrid battery failures
budget_items.what_was_said: The chief said three hybrid cruiser batteries failed this year around the same mileage, each costing roughly the same amount to replace, though covered by warranty this time.

budget_items.topic: Police collective bargaining agreement, next three years
budget_items.what_was_said: The chief said the new contract calls for salary increases over the next three years, with expenses otherwise level-funded.

decisions.decision: No further feedback was offered on the master plan steering committee's update, so it will be sent back to that committee as is.
DPW director asked to send his full outsourcing-vs-hiring cost spreadsheet to the finance committee.
Facilities director asked to present prior-year actual spending figures, not just budgeted amounts, in future budget presentations.
General agreement that budget presentations should better show revolving fund and grant revenue alongside general fund expenses, not just general fund spending.
Deployment timing for any new fourth-shift firefighters will be worked out with the town manager after contract negotiations and hiring are complete, rather than assumed to start July 1.

what_happened.line: The Select Board, School Committee and Moderator unanimously appointed Stephanie Quinn to the Montachusett Regional Vocational School Committee.
The boards also authorized a three-year Council on Aging services agreement with the Montachusett Regional Transit Authority.
The regular Tri-Board session that followed was entirely FY27 preliminary budget presentations from DPW, Facilities, Fire and Police, with no votes taken.
DPW outlined a proposed storm water utility fee and was asked to send its full analysis comparing town crews to outsourced snow and ice work to the finance committee.
Fire presented a proposed fourth career shift, with when any new hires would actually start left to be worked out later with the town manager.

why_it_matters: The proposed storm water utility would be a new fee on residential and business properties, separate from the tax bill, and is still in the preliminary stage.
A fourth fire shift and DPW staffing and equipment requests shown here will feed into the FY27 budget residents eventually vote on at town meeting.
No budget figures were adopted or voted at this meeting -- these were department presentations, not decisions.
